name: What are the common costs associated with purchasing an investment property?

mainEntity.name: What are the common costs associated with purchasing an investment property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Purchasing an investment property involves costs beyond the down payment, including closing costs, property taxes, insurance, potential HOA fees, and maintenance reserves. Closing costs typically range from 2-5% of the purchase price. Additionally, investors should budget for property management fees if they plan to outsource day-to-day operations. Understanding these costs upfront is crucial for financial planning, and we can provide a detailed breakdown relevant to specific property types and locations within the South Florida market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common costs include down payment, closing costs, property taxes, insurance, HOA fees, and maintenance reserves, all essential for financial planning.
